name: speaking-talk
description: Lingo Speek — full-stack English speaking-practice website (Node.js + Express + React 19 + TypeScript + shadcn/ui)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,DJANGO,WEB -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "python backend/django_admin/manage.py runserver 8000" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
